families.remainingObligation: Pure Hello/model boundary assertions exist; full domain/invariant enforcement is still owed.

families.remainingObligation: Hello orchestration, routing and model doubles exist; authorization ordering, compensation and domain workflows remain.

families.name: Persistence tests against real stores
families.remainingObligation: No current owned real-store transaction/isolation/migration suite; local Workflow emulation is not that evidence.

families.name: Serialization and type-shape compatibility
families.remainingObligation: Hello wire vectors and generated SDK shape exist; initial domain catalogue, exact numeric/time profiles and supported-version window remain.

families.name: Local RPC over real pipes and sockets
families.remainingObligation: No named-pipe/domain-socket suite; current HTTP/gRPC-Web Hello tests do not satisfy this family.

families.name: Public API generated-client real-server contracts
families.remainingObligation: Real Hello protocol consumers exist; complete methods, authorization fields and old/current client-server compatibility remain.

families.name: Native ABI per RID and error path
families.remainingObligation: Existing Windows probe CTests and packaged JIT/AOT/C17 checks; Metal/fuzz source is not an executed matrix. Functional ABI, helper containment, sanitizers and supported-RID coverage remain.

families.name: UI component and automation
families.remainingObligation: Hello native/browser/Android UI and lifecycle checks exist; full product workflows, locale/theme and visual acceptance remain.

families.name: Accessibility automated and assistive verification
families.remainingObligation: Automated browser axe/keyboard checks exist; dated real assistive-technology checks and full-product scenarios remain.

families.name: Integrated boundary tests
families.remainingObligation: Bootstrap desktop-to-Cloud and deployed AI Hello boundaries exist; packaged assistant/helper, product isolation and full workflows remain.

families.name: Migration and golden fixtures
families.remainingObligation: No current versioned store migration/semantic-preservation suite; Hello wire fixtures alone do not close it.

families.name: Crash fault injection and recovery
families.remainingObligation: No current process-crash/power-loss durable recovery suite; cancellation, activity recreation and mocked Workflow failures do not substitute.

families.name: Performance regression benchmarks
families.remainingObligation: No measured reference-hardware budget/regression suite; test timeouts and successful builds are not benchmarks.

families.name: Publish install update downgrade rollback
families.remainingObligation: Candidate integrity, publication and Android public upgrade checks exist; full installer/update/rollback/data-directory matrix remains.

families.name: Architecture and repository policy
families.remainingObligation: Substantive owner-local policy/provenance tests and five DesktopPlatform architecture tests exist; complete AT/RP manifest and per-invariant enforcement accounting remain.

families.name: Scope and Slate hardware lab
families.remainingObligation: No current Scope/Slate physical device/driver/timing lab suite; Android device or emulator tests are not this family.
